lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑过，鳍像两片翅膀。
lines.en: I glide along the sand, my fins like two wings.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我背上留下一层薄薄的伪装。
lines.en: A thin layer of sand settles over my back as camouflage.

lines.zh: 我拍一下胸鳍，就离海底半尺。
lines.en: One beat of my pectoral fins lifts me off the seabed.

lines.zh: 浅海的沙床是我的路，不是别人的。
lines.en: The sandy shelf of the shallows is my road, not yours.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，慢到你以为我是块石头。
lines.en: I swim so slowly you take me for a stone.

lines.zh: 一条鱼影掠过，我的尾巴先动。
lines.en: A fish shadow passes; my tail moves before I do.

lines.zh: 我把身体压平，沙面几乎不起波纹。
lines.en: I flatten my body until the sand barely ripples.

lines.zh: 暖流推着我，我顺着礁石的边缘走。
lines.en: A warm current pushes me along the reef's edge.

lines.zh: 我不用快，海底的路从不催我。
lines.en: I need no speed; the seafloor never hurries me.

lines.zh: 主世界的海比你想的安静，我习惯这样。
lines.en: The Overworld sea is quieter than you think; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我滑过海草，草叶只弯了一下。
lines.en: I slide past the seagrass; the blades bend only once.

lines.zh: 我的背是褐色的，沙也是褐色的。
lines.en: My back is brown, and so is the sand.

lines.zh: 我绕着沉船转，木板缝里没有吃的。
lines.en: I circle the shipwreck; nothing edible in the plank gaps.

lines.zh: 水里没有脚步声，只有我鳍的轻响。
lines.en: There are no footsteps underwater, only my fins' soft noise.

lines.zh: 我把胸鳍撑在沙上，歇一会
lines.en: I prop myself on my pectoral fins and rest.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西在动，我压低身
lines.en: Something moves in the sand; I press lower.

lines.zh: 我沿着礁盘慢慢巡一圈
lines.en: I patrol the reef ledge slowly, one round.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推回深一点的地方
lines.en: The tide pushes me back into deeper water.

lines.zh: 我停在沙上，鳃一张一合，很慢。
lines.en: I rest on the sand, gills opening and closing slowly.

lines.zh: 沙粒盖住我的背鳍，像多了一层皮。
lines.en: Sand grains cover my back fin like a second skin.

lines.zh: 沙从我的鳍边流下去，像细小的瀑布。
lines.en: Sand spills past my fins like a small waterfall.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等的不是风，是影子。
lines.en: I stay still, waiting not for wind but for a shadow.

lines.zh: 泡泡从我嘴边升起，到水面就没了。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my mouth and vanish at the surface.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，海底的声音却很清楚。
lines.en: My breath is shallow, yet the seafloor is loud to me.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在沙上，看着上面的光。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the sand and watch the light above.

lines.zh: 掠食者的耐心，比潮水还长。
lines.en: A predator's patience runs longer than the tide.

lines.zh: 一尾小鱼靠近，我没有动，它也没看见。
lines.en: A small fish comes near; I do not move, and it does not see.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会注意脚下的猎物。
lines.en: I wait for prey that never watches its own feet.

lines.zh: 海底的沙是软的，躺着比游着舒服。
lines.en: The seafloor sand is soft; lying beats swimming.

lines.zh: 我半睁着眼，礁石的影子盖住我。
lines.en: My eyes half open, the reef's shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 潮水退了又涨，我还在原处。
lines.en: The tide leaves and returns; I am still here.

lines.zh: 没有谁来找我，这样最好。
lines.en: No one comes looking for me, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我在沙里抬眼，先看你的靴子。
lines.en: I raise my eyes from the sand and look at your boots first.

lines.zh: 你站在我的沙床上，影子落下来。
lines.en: You stand on my sand bed, and your shadow falls.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在沙面下，像两粒湿石子。
lines.en: My eyes sit above the sand like two wet pebbles.

lines.zh: 你踩出的每一步，我数得很清。
lines.en: I count every step you press into the sand.

lines.zh: 我把头偏一点，看你手里的鱼桶。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the fish bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 你还没下水，我就知道你要来。
lines.en: Before you enter the water, I know you are coming.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，海底也没有风让我眨眼。
lines.en: I do not blink; the seafloor has no wind to make me.

lines.zh: 你的倒影落在沙上，比你先到。
lines.en: Your reflection reaches the sand before you do.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种站姿，脚跟不稳。
lines.en: I know that stance of yours; your heels are unsteady.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一条游得太高的鱼。
lines.en: I watch you like a fish that swims too high.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，可这一下还是疼。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but that still hurt.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，沙全扬起来了。
lines.en: I roll over and the sand flies up.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我不喜欢这味道。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and I dislike the taste.

lines.zh: 我咬紧颌，把疼咽进鳃里。
lines.en: I clench my jaws and swallow the pain through my gills.

lines.zh: 谁打的我，我记住那个方向。
lines.en: I remember the direction of whoever struck me.

lines.zh: 我往沙里钻，可沙不够深了。
lines.en: I dig into the sand, but it is not deep enough.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，只削掉一片鳍尖。
lines.en: That blow went wide and only clipped a fin tip.

lines.zh: 我喘得急，鳃盖一拍一拍地响。
lines.en: I breathe fast, gill covers clicking with each beat.

lines.zh: 疼让我更慢，也让我更近地贴沙。
lines.en: Pain slows me and presses me closer to the sand.

lines.zh: 我退了半尺，不是逃，是在算。
lines.en: I back off half a foot, not fleeing but calculating.

lines.zh: 你丢下的生鱼，比你的手更可信。
lines.en: The raw fish you drop is more trustworthy than your hands.

lines.zh: 我闻到血味，鳍尖就自己动了。
lines.en: I smell blood and my fin tips move on their own.

lines.zh: 别把鱼举高，我只在沙面上进食。
lines.en: Do not hold the fish high; I feed at sand level.

lines.zh: 你的鱼桶晃了一下，我听见了。
lines.en: Your fish bucket shifts, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我靠近，不是为了你，是为了那点腥。
lines.en: I come closer for that smell of fish, not for you.

lines.zh: 你把饵放在沙上，我才肯动。
lines.en: Put the bait on the sand and only then will I move.

lines.zh: 我张口不是咬你，是咬那条鱼。
lines.en: I open my mouth for the fish, not for you.

lines.zh: 海底的腥味顺流过来，我跟着游。
lines.en: The smell of fish drifts downstream and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我试探着靠近，鳍先碰了碰沙。
lines.en: I approach warily, fins brushing the sand first.

lines.zh: 你手上的鱼比你的脸更吸引我。
lines.en: The fish in your hand draws me more than your face.

lines.zh: 你撞上我扁平的背，像撞一块湿木板。
lines.en: You bump my flat back like a wet plank.

lines.zh: 我被推得侧过身，沙雾一下扬起来。
lines.en: I am shoved onto my side and a cloud of sand rises.

lines.zh: 我的皮粗得像砂纸，蹭过你的腿。
lines.en: My hide is rough as sandpaper against your leg.

lines.zh: 别踩我的胸鳍，那是我的翅膀。
lines.en: Do not step on my pectoral fins; those are my wings.

lines.zh: 我贴着你绕开，鳍扫过你的靴子。
lines.en: I slide around you, my fin brushing your boot.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我就往沙里沉了半寸。
lines.en: At your touch I sink half an inch into the sand.

lines.zh: 水被我搅浑，你看不清我了。
lines.en: I muddy the water until you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我没什么可让的，这条道是我的。
lines.en: I have nothing to yield; this path is mine.

lines.zh: 你退半步，沙面上留了一道印。
lines.en: You step back, leaving a groove in the sand.

lines.zh: 撞了也不出声，我只把身体压得更低。
lines.en: I make no sound, only press my body lower.

lines.zh: 我们在沙上并排趴着，鳍挨着鳍。
lines.en: We lie side by side on the sand, fin against fin.

lines.zh: 她把自己埋进沙里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: She buries herself and shows only her eyes.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块礁石，谁也不先走。
lines.en: We circle the same reef and neither leaves first.

lines.zh: 两条扁影叠在一起，沙就静了。
lines.en: Two flat shadows overlap and the sand goes still.

lines.zh: 我用鳍尖碰她，她的尾巴动了一下。
lines.en: I touch her with a fin tip; her tail flicks once.

lines.zh: 海底没有花，我们只有同一片沙床。
lines.en: There are no flowers down here, only one shared sand bed.

lines.zh: 她游得比我快，我跟在她尾后。
lines.en: She swims faster than I do; I follow her tail.

lines.zh: 我们并肩沉到沙上，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We sink onto the sand together and neither speaks.

lines.zh: 潮水把我们的痕迹一起抹平了。
lines.en: The tide smooths out both our tracks at once.

lines.zh: 这样安静的时刻，比追猎更难得。
lines.en: Such quiet moments are rarer than the hunt.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只有鳍，抓不住东西。
lines.en: I have no hands, only fins that cannot grip.

lines.zh: 骨粉落在我背上，我抖不掉。
lines.en: Bone meal lands on my back and I cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢在沙上，它就一直躺着。
lines.en: Whatever you drop on the sand simply stays there.

lines.zh: 我的嘴只咬活的，不捡死物。
lines.en: My mouth is for living prey, not for dead things.

lines.zh: 我用吻部顶了顶，那东西没动。
lines.en: I nudge it with my snout and it does not move.

lines.zh: 海底沉下的东西，最后都归沙。
lines.en: Whatever sinks to the seafloor ends up as sand.

lines.zh: 我没有地方装，鳍缝也夹不住。
lines.en: I have nowhere to keep it; nothing fits between my fins.

lines.zh: 你别指望我替你捡起那块铁。
lines.en: Do not expect me to pick up that iron for you.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，不是鱼，我就游开了。
lines.en: I sniff it; it is not fish, so I swim off.

lines.zh: 地上的东西对你重要，对我只是杂物。
lines.en: Things on the ground matter to you; to me they are clutter.

lines.zh: 你的脚打起沙雾，我盯住了那团雾。
lines.en: Your feet stir up sand, and I fix on that cloud.

lines.zh: 我选中最小的那个，通常最好抓。
lines.en: I pick the smallest one; it is usually the easiest.

lines.zh: 你流血了，海里的味道就变了。
lines.en: You are bleeding, and the taste of the sea changes.

lines.zh: 我在沙里转了个方向，冲着你。
lines.en: I turn under the sand until I face you.

lines.zh: 掠食者不挑时候，只挑落单的。
lines.en: A predator chooses no hour, only the one alone.

lines.zh: 你游得太靠底了，正好在我的高度。
lines.en: You swim too low, right at my level.

lines.zh: 我的鳍张开，那不是欢迎的意思。
lines.en: My fins spread, and that is not a welcome.

lines.zh: 你踩在我埋身的沙上，我记住了你。
lines.en: You stepped on the sand hiding me; I remember you.

lines.zh: 这条鱼受伤了，我改主意了。
lines.en: That fish is wounded; I have changed my mind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起身体，沙从背上滑落。
lines.en: I slowly lift myself and sand slides off my back.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子，贴着沙走。
lines.en: I follow your shadow, hugging the sand.

lines.zh: 你往礁石缝里躲，我等在外面。
lines.en: You hide in a reef crack; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，堵住你回岸的方向。
lines.en: I swing half around to block your way to shore.

lines.zh: 你越游越急，我的呼吸反而更慢。
lines.en: The more you hurry, the slower my breathing gets.

lines.zh: 沙雾里那道扁影，一直不离你三尺。
lines.en: That flat shadow in the sand haze stays three feet off.

lines.zh: 我不追声音，我追水里的慌。
lines.en: I do not chase noise; I chase the panic in the water.

lines.zh: 你回头看了一眼，我正好在你看的地方。
lines.en: You glance back, and I am exactly where you looked.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底跟，省着力气等你累。
lines.en: I trail along the bottom, saving strength until you tire.

lines.zh: 你想上岸，可岸边还有我的同伴。
lines.en: You want the shore, but my kin are near it too.

lines.zh: 我离你越来越近，沙却越来越静。
lines.en: I draw nearer and the sand grows quieter.

lines.zh: 沙炸开，我从底下冲上来咬住你。
lines.en: The sand bursts and I lunge up to bite.

lines.zh: 我的牙往里钩，咬住就不松。
lines.en: My teeth hook inward and hold once they close.

lines.zh: 你不该站在我的沙床上。
lines.en: You should not have stood on my sand bed.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在小腿上，然后拧身。
lines.en: I bite your calf and twist my whole body.

lines.zh: 水一下变红，我看得更清楚了。
lines.en: The water reddens, and I see more clearly.

lines.zh: 我的颌骨一合，像两扇湿门关上。
lines.en: My jaws close like two wet doors shutting.

lines.zh: 我从侧面来，你根本来不及转身。
lines.en: I come from the side; you cannot turn in time.

lines.zh: 这一咬不是为了吃，是为了让你走。
lines.en: This bite is not for food but to drive you off.

lines.zh: 我松开，退进沙雾里，再等你。
lines.en: I let go, sink into the sand haze, and wait again.

lines.zh: 我的牙断了还会长，你的腿不会。
lines.en: My teeth grow back; your leg will not.

lines.zh: 我从沙里升起，背先破开沙面。
lines.en: I rise from the sand, my back breaking the surface first.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一落地，我就在浅海里成形。
lines.en: The spawn egg lands, and I take shape in the shallows.

lines.zh: 主世界的海滩给了我第一片沙。
lines.en: The Overworld beach gives me my first sand.

lines.zh: 我先学会埋自己，再学会游。
lines.en: I learn to bury myself before I learn to swim.

lines.zh: 海水灌进鳃里，我就知道该动了。
lines.en: Water fills my gills and I know it is time to move.

lines.zh: 群系的暖水把我送到这片礁边。
lines.en: The warm water of this biome carries me to the reef.

lines.zh: 我出生时很扁，像一片落下的叶子。
lines.en: I am born flat, like a fallen leaf.

lines.zh: 沙床认得我，我一落下去就贴住了。
lines.en: The sand bed knows me; I settle the moment I land.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推到浅处，我就在这住下。
lines.en: The tide pushes me shallow, and here I stay.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，是从沙缝里吸的。
lines.en: My first breath is drawn from a gap in the sand.

lines.zh: 海水里也有火，烫得我往深处钻。
lines.en: Fire reaches even here; I dive deeper from the heat.

lines.zh: 我从半空摔进海里，摔得鳍都麻了。
lines.en: I fall from the air into the sea, fins numb.

lines.zh: 我在水里却喘不上气，这太荒唐。
lines.en: I cannot breathe while in water, which is absurd.

lines.zh: 炸开的水压把我掀翻在礁石上。
lines.en: The blast's pressure flips me onto the reef.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进沙里，差点钉住我的鳍。
lines.en: An arrow stabs the sand and nearly pins my fin.

lines.zh: 那股药水味钻进鳃里，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: That potion reek seeps into my gills and numbs me.

lines.zh: 沙床空了三天，我的肚子贴到脊骨。
lines.en: Three days with an empty bed and my belly meets my spine.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，我的鳍尖还留着麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows and my fin tips still tingle.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界的边缘，连沙都没有了。
lines.en: I fall past the world's edge where no sand remains.
